outputs.headline: False: Hot water with lemon does not destroy coronavirus
outputs.summary: There is no scientific evidence that drinking hot water with lemon juice can destroy, cure, or prevent the coronavirus.
outputs.what_post_claims: The post claims that drinking hot water mixed with lemon juice will destroy the coronavirus.
outputs.what_is_true: There is no scientific evidence that drinking hot water with lemon juice can destroy, cure, or prevent the coronavirus. Health organizations and fact-checkers have consistently debunked this claim.
evidence_against: AFP Fact Check states experts found no proof that warm water with lemon prevents COVID-19.
FactCheck.org debunks the claim that lemon juice kills the coronavirus, with an infectious diseases physician confirming no supporting data.
The National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine states that the acid in lemon juice will not kill coronaviruses in the body.
